segments.sn23.4:1.2: Āyasmā rādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rādhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn23.4:2.1: “Pariññeyye ca, rādha, dhamme desessāmi pariññañca pariññātāviṃ puggalañca.
segments.sn23.4:2.2: Taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.sn23.4:2.3: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā rādho bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.sn23.4:2.6: Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, pariññeyyo dhammo, vedanā pariññeyyo dhammo, saññā pariññeyyo dhammo, saṅkhārā pariññeyyo dhammo, viññāṇaṃ pariññeyyo dhammo.
segments.sn23.4:2.9: Yo kho, rādha, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo –

lines: Tatra satto tatra visattoti tatra laggo tatra vilaggo.
Mamāyantīti “mama idaṃ, mama ida”nti mamattaṃ karonti, aññassa phusitumpi na denti.
Vikīḷaniyaṃ karontīti “niṭṭhitā kīḷā”ti te bhindamānā kīḷāvigamaṃ karonti.
Pañcamādīsu catūsu cattāri saccāni kathitāni, dvīsu kilesappahānanti.
Yadi rūpādīsu sattattā satto, khīṇāsavā kathaṃ sattāti?
Yantarajju viya bhavapabandhassa nayanato bhavarajjūti taṇhā vuttā.
